threads.description: YTubViral launch thread — 14 tools, waitlist CTA
tweets:
I built 14 AI tools for YouTubers in one platform.

Not a YouTuber myself — I'm a factory automation engineer from Spain who spent months in creator forums understanding what people actually struggle with.

Here's what's inside YTubViral and why I built each one 🧵

The #1 problem I saw: creators spending hours on titles and descriptions.

So I built an AI generator that creates 5 options in seconds — titles, descriptions, scripts, captions, and thumbnail concepts.

Not generic stuff. You describe your video, it adapts.

Then I noticed creators had no idea if their videos were optimized.

SEO Score analyzes title, description, tags, captions, engagement — gives a score out of 100 with a checklist of what to fix.

Simple. Actionable.

Keyword Research was next.

Type any topic → get search volume, competition level, and the top 5 ranking videos.

Find what people are searching for before you record, not after.

Competitor Analysis: enter any YouTube channel URL and see their metrics, upload frequency, top videos, and growth trends.

Know what's working in your niche.

Content Calendar with AI suggestions.

Plan your uploads visually. Click "AI Scheduler" and it suggests topics + optimal upload times based on your audience data.

And there's more:
- A/B Testing (test 2 titles on a live video)
- Best Time to Post (heatmap)
- Retention Analyzer
- Revenue Estimator
- AI Coach
- Trend Explorer
- Video Predictor
- Learning Hub

14 tools. One login.

Pricing: free plan (10 generations/month), Pro at €9.99/mo, Business at €29.99/mo.

We're launching on Product Hunt soon.

Early waitlist = 50% off for a full year.

👉 https://ytubviral.com/launch
